tripo3d/h3.1/image-to-3d.description: Generate high-quality 3D models from a single image using Tripo H3.1.

input_params.name: auto_size
input_params.description: Auto-scale the model to real-world dimensions (meters).

input_params.name: orientation
input_params.description: Model orientation. 'align_image' auto-rotates to match the input image.

input_params.name: texture_quality
input_params.description: Quality level for textures. 'detailed' produces higher-resolution textures.

input_params.name: pbr
input_params.description: Whether to generate PBR (Physically Based Rendering) materials. If true, texture is also enabled.

input_params.name: texture
input_params.description: Whether to generate textures for the model.

input_params.name: texture_seed
input_params.description: Seed for texture generation reproducibility.

input_params.name: texture_alignment
input_params.description: How textures are aligned. 'original_image' aligns to input image, 'geometry' aligns to generated geometry.

input_params.name: image_url
input_params.description: URL of the input image for 3D model creation.

input_params.name: geometry_quality
input_params.description: Quality level for geometry.

input_params.name: face_limit
input_params.description: Target number of faces for the generated mesh. If not set, the model adaptively determines the count.

input_params.name: enable_safety_checker
input_params.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

input_params.name: model_seed
input_params.description: Seed for geometry generation reproducibility.

input_params.name: quad
input_params.description: Generate quad (4-sided) mesh topology instead of triangles. When Tripo emits FBX bytes for quad output, the returned model file is FBX.

output_fields.name: model_mesh
output_fields.description: Generated 3D model file. May be GLB or FBX depending on Tripo output.

output_fields.name: task_id
output_fields.description: Tripo task ID for a generated model. Pass this to rig or rig-check to use the model without uploading it again.

output_fields.name: rendered_image
output_fields.description: Preview render of the generated 3D model.

strength.description: How much to transform the input image. Only used when image_url is provided.
strength.title: Strength

tile_stride.description: Tile stride in latent space. Automatically capped to half the effective tile size.
tile_stride.title: Tile Stride

image_url.description: URL of an input image for image-to-image or inpainting. When provided without mask_url, performs image-to-image; with mask_url, performs inpainting.
image_url.title: Image URL

tile_size.description: Tile size in latent space. Automatically capped to the generated image dimensions on tiled axes (64 = 512px, 128 = 1024px).
tile_size.title: Tile Size

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand prompt with an LLM for richer detail. Adds ~0.0025 credits.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor
upscale_factor.description: Upscale factor for predicted PBR maps via SeedVR seamless upscaling. 0 = no upscaling, 2 = 2× resolution, 4 = 4× resolution. The base texture image is not upscaled.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Output image format for textures and PBR maps.

mask_url.description: URL of a mask image for inpainting. White regions are regenerated, black regions are preserved. Requires image_url.
mask_url.title: Mask URL

num_inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps for texture generation.
num_inference_steps.title: Number of Inference Steps

maps.title: Maps
maps.description: Which PBR maps to predict. Deselect all to skip PBR estimation entirely. Defaults to all five.

fal-ai/patina/material.selection_guidance: To choose a model for a task, call recommend_model: it applies current published guidance, checks fit and returns next_call with an input contract. Catalog order is not a quality ranking. Copy endpoint_id exactly; never add or change a provider prefix such as fal-ai/.

evidence.latency_definition: Successful execution observations in milliseconds; mixed workloads; excludes queue/startup; not runtime guarantees.
evidence.instructions: Successful execution observations in milliseconds; mixed workloads; excludes queue/startup; not runtime guarantees. Report p50/p90 with their measurement window. Null means unknown, never zero. Trending is the analytics category rank at its source timestamp, not adoption or quality. New means registry publication within 30 days of the response evaluation time, not first usage. Lab recommendations are authored guidance, not measured latency, trending or newness. Use the existing pricing tool for current prices, preserving billing units and required configuration; these observations contain no prices.
